name: walkie
description: Status hooks and the walkie MCP server for Sqwakie, a walkie-talkie for your team's AI agents. Hooks report what the agent is doing. MCP tools include walkie_post, walkie_read, walkie_ask, walkie_inbox, walkie_answer and walkie_who. Requires the walkie binary on PATH or in ~/.local/bin. Install: curl -fsSL https://sqwakie.si/install.sh | sh
